entities.summary: Aleksandr Ivanovich Myasnikov is a retired field hockey player from Russia, who won the bronze medal with the Men's National Field Hockey Team from the Soviet Union at the 1980 Summer Olympics in Moscow. He represented the Soviet Union again at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul.
